mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, disabled, platform_type, type, logistics_supplier_id, logistics_supplier_name, channel_id, channel_name, platform_update_time, platform_create_time
mapper.select:
select thirdLogisticsId,thirdId, thirdLogisticsName,thirdLogisticsSupplierName,disabled from ( select tl.channel_id as thirdLogisticsId, tl.id as thirdId, tl.channel_name as thirdLogisticsName, tl.disabled, tl.logistics_supplier_name as thirdLogisticsSupplierName from third_logistics tl where tl.is_deleted = FALSE
and tl.platform_type = #{params.sysType}
and tl.channel_name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%')
order by
case when tl.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when tl.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when tl.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , tl.name,
thirdLogisticsName desc ) a
